## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Permanently delete one of the user's Coach skills. There is no undo. Only call this when they ask to delete that skill. It turns off in every chat, and any routine using it runs without it.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | The skill to delete, from list_skills. Max length 40. |
